items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: he was writing a piece for the Woody Herman band... we learned to play the music, and presented it at Carnegie Hall in 1946... we decided we would record it

ctx.x: I think that was probably the most thrilling -- it was, undoubtedly, that ever happened in my musical career and life. To receive a telegram from Igor Stravinsky, saying that he had heard some of our music and he

was now writing a piece -- he was writing a piece for the Woody Herman band. And this -- I received this, I think, probably along about October, this telegram. And he said, "I hope to have the piece completed and will come to New York and bring it in time for Christmas to you -- to the men in the band and you."
